subject.title: fix(ios): "Jump to latest" no longer appears while the assistant is still writing

question: Is the PR-body claim of a deleted scratch XCUITest sufficient for this native SwiftUI scroll-state change, or should merge require an inspectable redacted simulator/device artifact covering the three stated visibility states?
rationale: The patch affects behavior that depends on real scroll geometry and streaming lifecycle, while the available evidence is only a prose claim plus pure helper tests; the protected label means this proof gate should be decided by a human.

options.title: Require inspectable native proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted simulator or device recording, screenshots with accessibility state, or a reproducible runtime transcript showing hide-at-edge, show-after-scroll-away, and hide-after-return.

options.title: Accept the claimed validation
options.body: Treat the described scratch XCUITest and focused pure tests as sufficient and continue normal maintainer review without an attached runtime artifact.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable native proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted simulator or device recording, screenshots with accessibility state, or a reproducible runtime transcript showing hide-at-edge, show-after-scroll-away, and hide-after-return.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the implementation and the only described native validation, so they are the most direct person to clarify or provide the missing evidence.
